assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: polished title-screen background for SHIOGAERI, a Japanese coastal salvage indie game.
Create one landscape 3:2 illustration, 1536x1024 composition. A dawn-flooded abandoned Japanese fishing harbor, viewed from inside wet broken timber-and-concrete architecture. Quiet dark shadow and textured walls occupy the LEFT 40 percent, intentionally simple and low contrast so native game title lettering can be placed there later. On the right half a small back-facing scavenger in an ocher hooded raincoat, heavy boots, a big worn satchel and a small warm lantern stands on a wet jetty facing a distant slender lighthouse. Floodwater among roofs, mooring ropes, crooked wooden pilings, rusted fishing equipment and crumbling harbor structures. Purposeful depth and light lead from the traveler to the distant lighthouse. Ocher traveler is small relative to the environment.
Style: handcrafted hand-painted gouache with fine etched ink linework, weathered paper texture, confident irregular brush edges and restrained detail. Desaturated slate/navy/teal, oxidized rust, ocher coat and warm cream dawn light. Evocative, eerie but quietly hopeful, carefully composed indie game concept art. Rich material differentiation, strong value hierarchy. No neon, pixel art, glossy 3D, cartoons, generic geometric placeholder art.
NO words, letters, typography, UI, borders, logos, signatures or watermark. Keep left 40 percent quiet and dark. Complete standalone scene.
